schema: Execution log for each daily-brief run. One entry per run.

fields.started: ISO datetime when the run started
fields.completed: ISO datetime when the run completed
fields.model: Friendly name of the MAIN agent's model — verbatim from the AI-content notice; the prompt deliberately gives no example to avoid biasing self-identification
fields.model_id: Canonical model id of the main agent — verbatim from the backticks in the AI-content notice
fields.sub_agents.<key>.model: Friendly name reported by the sub-agent's **Model:** line
fields.sub_agents.<key>.model_id: Canonical id of the sub-agent's model; 'unknown' if absent
fields.sub_agents.<key>.telemetry: Optional self-reported runtime telemetry (duration_seconds, webfetch_calls, websearch_calls, bridge_fetches, tokens_in, tokens_out)
fields.deep_dive_category: Category slug for this run's deep dive
fields.new_cves_added: Count of new CVEs added to cves_seen.json
fields.new_items_added: Count of new items added to covered_items.json
fields.items_updated: Count of existing items updated in covered_items.json
fields.sources_consulted: Approximate count of distinct sources fetched
fields.notes: Run notes, errors encountered, or items deferred

runs.notes: Standard daily window (gap 24h, window 36h). Deep dive: Microsoft Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-26030 / CVE-2026-25592 — prompt-injection-to-RCE in AI agent orchestration framework (cloud-saas category, fresh rotation). § 1 items: Groupe 3R Akira (Swiss healthcare critical infra, 20 imaging centres in 7 Romandie cantons), Braintrust AWS account breach, JDownloader supply-chain compromise. § 2: Microsoft Semantic Kernel summary. § 3: Bauman/GRU joint investigation, PCPJack cloud worm (SentinelLabs), Sophos Beagle/fake Claude site, ClickFix macOS expansion. § 4 UPDATEs: Canvas/Instructure (second-intrusion claim, 7 Dutch unis disconnect, May 12 deadline), Ivanti EPMM (KEV deadline expired today, 508 EU exposed of ~850 globally, +CVE-2026-5786/5788/5787/7821 in same patch), cPanel embargo lifted (CVE-2026-29201/29202/29203), DENIC DNSSEC post-mortem (Key Tag 33834 collision). Dropped from § 2: Cisco Unity Connection CVE-2026-20034/20035 (8.8/7.2 don't clear gates; logged § 7). Dropped from § 3 per PD-11: TCLBANKER (off-audience), CallPhantom (off-audience). Held: Laclinic-Montreux/Qilin (single dark-web aggregator, no victim statement). Phase 4.5 verification: 2 iterations. Iteration 1 truth=6/editorial=4/advisory=5; remediations applied (wrong Elastic URL, wrong CIS advisory URL, blocked CISA news-events URL, unsourced superlative, CVE patch version clarification, vendor-list softening, Fribourg canton add, JDownloader RAT description softening, Groupe 3R 2025 incident framing, Canvas figure de-precision). Iteration 2 truth=4/editorial=3/advisory=3; remediations applied (companion CVE inventory completed, superlative removed from § 4 body, IOC false-positive context word added). NCSC-CH Security Hub URLs use API endpoint format (/api/posts/NNN/details) per 2026-05-09 convention to bypass SPA-hash-fragment checker false-positive. Sub-agent self-id drift: all four S* wrote 'Claude Sonnet 4.5' as friendly name with model id `claude-sonnet-4-6`; verifier iteration 2 self-id'd as 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' (correct). Documented in § 7. URL liveness WARNs for SSL cert errors on groupe3r.ch / ivanti.com / sophos.com / malwarebytes.com / cyberkendra.com — likely CA-bundle / clock issue in routine container, URLs verified live by sub-agents at fetch time. 403 on blick.ch / lemonde.fr / theguardian.com — anti-bot transport blocks; sub-agent fetches succeeded at research time.

W1.focus: Long-horizon ongoing developments and annual/periodic reports

W2.focus: Strategic and policy horizon (Switzerland + Europe + public sector)
